delivery.description: Tracking/status timestamps and has_proof; never a private file path.

proof.description: Required for delivered. JPEG/PNG, max 5 MB; send multipart.

EnrollmentInput.description: Multipart enrollment; existing role age, location, uniqueness and document requirements apply. Password+confirmation required unless verified google_access_token supplied (then both prohibited). Buyer/Seller require region_code. Seller additionally requires seller_type, business_name, business_category_id, TIN 000-000-000-000 and business_permit; sole proprietor adds dti_certificate/bir_2303, corporation sec_certificate/bir_2303. Rider additionally requires logistics_center_id, vehicle_type, plate_number, license and vehicle_registration. See RegisterAccountRequest, SellerRules and RiderRegistrationRules.

price.description: Peso decimal string; maximum two decimal places.

expected_stock.description: Required on update: stock from last read.
Required with an existing row id.

access_token.description: Returned once; OS secure storage required.

RoleResponse.description: Role-scoped allow-listed response. This is a flexible response schema, not a generated typed client contract. See ROLE_COVERAGE.md and the referenced Laravel action for exact fields. Resource collections: data/links/meta. RoleData paginators: data.data/current_page/last_page.
